item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Vietnam Veteran Era Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco's Deluxe Low Profile Vietnam Veteran Era Cap is the perfect way to show pride and honor. This baseball-styled cap features high-quality, raised embroidered "Vietnam Veteran" lettering along with the Vietnam Veteran ribbon on the front panel, offering a bold and patriotic statement. The sandwich-style brim also includes a subtle woven label for added detail. Made from a durable and comfortable brushed cotton twill, the veteran cap provides all-day comfort, featuring a non-woven sweatband to wick away moisture.
description: Rothco's Deluxe Low Profile Vietnam Veteran Era Cap is the perfect way to show pride and honor. This baseball-styled cap features high-quality, raised embroidered "Vietnam Veteran" lettering along with the Vietnam Veteran ribbon on the front panel, offering a bold and patriotic statement. The sandwich-style brim also includes a subtle woven label for added detail. Made from a durable and comfortable brushed cotton twill, the veteran cap provides all-day comfort, featuring a non-woven sweatband to wick away moisture. The adjustable hook & loop closure at the back ensures a secure, customizable fit for most head sizes. Whether for daily wear, special occasions, or a thoughtful gift, this rugged cap is a must-have for veterans and supporters alike. Keep your head in the game with Rothco’s collection of headwear and accessories. Designed with precision and purpose, our headgear is built to withstand the harshest conditions. Whether you’re tackling the cold in one of our Watch Caps or Balaclavas, or out on a mission in a Boonie Hat or Fatigue Cap, our diverse range of headwear provides unmatched comfort and protection for everyone from military personnel to outdoor enthusiasts.
